title: NavTree
description: Sidebar navigation with sections, expandable branches, an active item and a compact icon-only mode. Arrow keys move between items and open or close branches.

support.notes: React sections/id and legacy items/value schemas, active ancestor expansion, controlled/default expanded ids, collapsed/wrapped labels, descriptions/icons, query and configured filtering, guarded item selection and native page navigation. Use native page URLs for href. React router renderLink is represented by native selection events and slots; DOM link rendering is not supported. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

translationResources.title: NavTree
translationResources.description: Sidebar navigation with sections, expandable branches, an active item and a compact icon-only mode. Arrow keys move between items and open or close branches.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Branches containing the active item open automatically; collapsing one is remembered. Items can have icons, descriptions and trailing content.

collapsed.title: Compact mode and wrapping
collapsed.description: collapsed shows icons only; wrapLabels wraps long labels instead of truncating them.

custom-link.title: Router links
custom-link.description: renderLink renders leaf items with your router's link; keep state.className on it. Expanded branches can be controlled.

NavTreeProps.activeId: Id of the active (current page) item; its ancestors expand
NavTreeProps.wrapLabels: Wraps long labels and descriptions instead of truncating them
NavTreeProps.expandedIds: Expanded branch ids (controlled; pair with onExpandedChange)
NavTreeProps.onExpandedChange: Called with the expanded branch ids when a branch is toggled
NavTreeProps.onItemSelect: Called when a leaf link or a branch is activated
NavTreeProps.renderLink: Custom rendering of leaf links (e.g. a router Link); put state.className on it
NavTreeProps.aria-labelledby: id(s) of the element(s) labelling the <nav> landmark (replaces the default label)

NavTreeItem.id: Unique id (matched against activeId / expanded ids)
NavTreeItem.label: Visible label
NavTreeItem.description: Secondary line under the label (hidden for nested items)
NavTreeItem.href: Link target of a leaf item
NavTreeItem.endContent: Trailing content, e.g. a badge or a count
NavTreeItem.children: Child items; the item becomes an expandable branch

NavTreeItemState.active: The item is the active one
NavTreeItemState.ancestorActive: A descendant of the item is active
NavTreeItemState.collapsed: The tree is in compact mode
NavTreeItemState.className: Class names to put on the rendered link

cssVars.--nav-tree-item-height: Minimum height of a top-level row (defaults to the density's control height)
cssVars.--nav-tree-item-padding-x: Horizontal padding of a row (follows the density's row padding)
cssVars.--nav-tree-item-radius: Corner radius of a row (defaults to --radius-md)
cssVars.--nav-tree-active-color: Accent color of the active row's icon
cssVars.--nav-tree-hover-background: Background of a hovered row (defaults to --hover-color)
cssVars.--nav-tree-guide-color: Color of the optional indent guide of an expanded branch (transparent by default)
cssVars.--nav-tree-guide-active-color: Color of the indent guide of the branch holding the active row

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Sections, icons, trailing counts and a branch from the sections property. minerva-select is canceled to route on the client and move active-id.

collapsed.title: Compact mode
collapsed.description: collapsed keeps the icons only, for a narrow sidebar; the labels remain the accessible names.

expansion.title: Controlled expansion
expansion.description: expandedIds sets the open branches and minerva-expanded-change is cancelable (Getting started stays open); wrap-labels wraps long labels.

events.minerva-select: A leaf link / action or a branch was activated (detail: { value, item }); cancelable: preventDefault() also prevents the link navigation (client-side routing).
events.minerva-expanded-change: A branch was expanded or collapsed by the user (detail: { expandedIds, item, expanded }); cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current state.
